title: Master Architecture A Integration and Canonical Specification Across Closed-Chain, Enthesis, and Thermal Constraints

TARGET-FORCE20.rationale: Closed-chain Strategy 2 reaches +21.64% bilateral force with Case 2C SF_local=2.05 at 4800 N; extreme ballistic 100% MVC (7661 N) drops local enthesis SF to 1.31 < 1.50 without extra CSA or dF/dt cap.

EXP-0061_LegPress.rationale: 0/6 audited datasets pass open bilateral isometric leg press requirements; DPValid single-joint reference yields Outcome 3 INCONCLUSIVE (N=20).

TARGET-ADAPT25.rationale: Uncoordinated +25% adaptation accelerates transient tendon damage 2.94x around week 3.0; risk eliminated (1.00x) only under tendon-paced progression H2.

TARGET-CPE45.rationale: Continuous 360 W breaches 39.5 C in all tested climates (temperate 20 C in 2365 s, hot-humid 32 C in 1350 s); safe over 2700 s only via intermittent pacing (D <= 0.92 at 20 C, D <= 0.65 at 32 C/80%RH) or active external cooling.

AEGIS-01.rationale: Skin barrier (-35% evaporative conductance, +2 kg) reduces temperate safe duty cycle by 14.0% at 300 W and 25.0% at 360 W, compounding BLOCKER-01.

Architecture_B.rationale: Preserved from DEC-0021 (compartment syndrome, microvascular ischemia, periosteal avulsion).

Architecture_C.rationale: Preserved from DEC-0021 (internal heat rejection and reflex latency incompatibilities).
